name: Report to Kadrak
summary: At Malaka'jin, Darn Talongrip sends Horde warriors north to Kadrak's watch post. The dispatch carries them from defending Stonetalon's crags to the campaign in Ashenvale, where the Horde holds outposts at Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand.

sections.title: A Call to the Northern Front
sections.body: Darn Talongrip watches the Horde's southern and mountain frontiers from Malaka'jin. The orc sees capable fighters passing through Stonetalon and directs them toward the northern Barrens watch tower. Ashenvale is the greater pressure point, where night elf sentinels clash with Warsong lumber gatherers. The Horde needs fighters there as the struggle over the forest continues.

sections.title: Kadrak's Watch
sections.body: Kadrak oversees Horde troop movements from a watch tower in the northern Barrens, where the savannah meets Ashenvale. The Horde holds outposts at the Zoram Strand in the west and Splintertree Post to the north. Kadrak coordinates supplies, troops, and urgent reports across the contested forest.

faq.q: Who sends you to Kadrak from Stonetalon?
aliases: who starts report to kadrak stonetalon
faq.answer: Darn Talongrip, an orc at the Horde outpost of Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, sends capable adventurers toward the forest border.
Kadrak is at the northern watch tower in the Barrens, guarding the main road north into Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Horde recruiting warriors for Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde needs lumber to sustain Orgrimmar and holds fortified positions at the Zoram Strand and Splintertree Post. Night elf resistance means commanders need reinforcements to secure the territory.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Kadrak?
faq.answer: Kadrak briefs you on Ashenvale and gives you reports to deliver and collect across the contested outposts in The Warsong Reports.

faq.q: Is this quest different from the Barrens version?
faq.answer: Both dispatches send you to Kadrak at the Ashenvale border. One comes from Crossroads in the Barrens, the other from the Stonetalon Mountains, and either leads into the Ashenvale campaign.

faq.q: What is the Zoram Strand mentioned in the briefing?
faq.answer: The Zoram Strand is a coastal region in northwestern Ashenvale along the Veiled Sea. The Horde holds a fortified beach outpost there to support military movements and secure naval access.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior, you join the Warchief's wider war effort, sent from the frontier into the struggle for Ashenvale's resources.
As an orc, you enter a campaign vital to the Warsong clan and Durotar's survival. Kadrak's post is a proving ground for young orc warriors.

As a tauren, you travel under the guidance of Horde lookouts like Darn Talongrip. They help travelers cross the mountain borders and keep communication open between bloodhoof lands and the Warchief's northern front.
